message.text: Identified this as a memos repository. Searching for components that handle attachment link staleness, refresh schedules, and server startup wiring.

The component appears to be `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`, which refreshes S3 presigned URLs to prevent staleness.

Reading `runner.go` and `server.go` to determine the schedule and startup wiring.
The `s3presign` runner looks like the stale-link refresher. I'll read it and how server startup starts it.

The S3 presign runner (`s3presign.Runner`) refreshes external attachment links every 12 hours.

It is wired into server startup via `Server.Start`, which calls `startBackgroundRunners` at line 129 of `server/server.go`. The runner is created and started within that same function around lines 162–171.

The exact wiring site is `server/server.go:153`, where `startBackgroundRunners` is defined. The final answer will begin with `h01.`.

h01.
s3presign.Runner — every 12 hours — server/server.go:129

`s3presign.Runner` re-presigns S3 attachment URLs so stored links do not expire. `runnerInterval` is `time.Hour * 12` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`. Server startup starts it from `Server.Start` via `startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:129`), which constructs the runner, runs it once immediately, then loops on that schedule.
